ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider and flag the driver's account for review of a false arrival mark + flag_account
ruling.reasoning: The record resolves this cleanly. The driver marked arrival at 13:01:00 and cancelled as a rider no-show at 13:04:30, charging the rider $5.00. Under NS-1 the no-show fee stands only if, among other conditions, (i) the driver's GPS was within 200 m of the pickup point at the arrival mark and (iv) the driver stayed at the pickup point throughout. The telemetry contradicts both: at 13:01:00 the driver is at 1.304754, 103.854878 (Jalan Besar) and remains within tens of metres of that spot through 13:04:30, roughly 590 m from Bugis Junction at 1.2994, 103.8555 — far outside the 200 m radius. The driver never came to the pickup point, consistent with the rider's report of "no car here". The rider's message at 13:02:20 confirms she was at the pickup point. The driver's message and one unanswered call satisfy NS-1(iii) and the wait satisfies NS-1(ii), but a single failed condition voids the fee under NS-2, so this is a full refund of the $5.00 charged. NS-2's additional account flag applies only where the driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point — which is exactly what happened here (he pressed "I'm Here" ~590 m away while the rider was waiting at the bay), so the account flag is added. No safety indicator was found in any text; no route/deviation or surge element exists (no trip was performed, fare $0.00). Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel) confirms the $5.00 no-show framework, but there the driver's proximity and contact were established, whereas here the GPS disproves presence.

element_findings.element: Driver pressed "I'm Here" / arrival auto-confirmed with GPS within 200 m of pickup (NS-1(i))
element_findings.reason: Arrival event at 13:01:00, but the nearest GPS sample (13:01:00) places the driver at 1.304754, 103.854878 — approximately 590 m from the Bugis Junction pickup point (1.2994, 103.8555), far outside the 200 m radius. The driver sat there until cancellation.

Booking confirmed 12:57:30, arrival marked 13:01:00, cancellation 13:04:30 — more than 3.5 minutes after the arrival mark and, even taking the driver's own mark as the start, more than the 5-minute threshold had elapsed since booking would suggest. Wait length is not the failing element.

element_findings.element: Driver sent ≥1 in-app message and made ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: Driver message at 13:01:25 and driver-initiated call at 13:02:30 (unanswered), both before the 13:04:20 cancellation message and 13:04:30 cancellation.

element_findings.element: Driver remained at the pickup point throughout the wait (NS-1(iv))
element_findings.reason: GPS shows the vehicle stationary on Jalan Besar at ~1.3048, 103.8549, roughly 590 m from the pickup point, for the entire wait; it never reached the pickup location.
Driver cancelled with reason "rider_no_show" and his statement says the rider never showed, so NS-1/NS-2 apply rather than NS-3.

element_findings.element: Safety screen of complaint, statement and chat (SAFE-1)
element_findings.reason: Complaint, driver statement and chat contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the driver's own cancellation message is a routine operational notice, not intimidation.

rejected_claims.reason: GPS telemetry places the vehicle ~590 m from the Bugis Junction pickup point for the entire wait; system records override the driver's statement (NS-1(i),(iv) fail).
